# Hermes Agents Forge — Setup Instructions

## For Hermes Agents

When a user points you at this page or the GitHub repo:

1. **Go to the GitHub repo:** https://github.com/juliench82/hermes-agents-forge
2. **Read `HERMES.md`** — It has the exact commands to run
3. **Follow the instructions in `HERMES.md`**

## Quick Summary

1. Install skills: `hermes -p default skills install onboarding-loop team-designer`
2. Run onboarding: `hermes -p default chat "Start onboarding"`

That's it. The onboarding loop handles everything else.

## What Happens Next

The `onboarding-loop` skill will:
1. Ask the user 3 questions (use case, role, goals)
2. Generate a custom team of 3-7 specialist bots
3. Create profiles with `hermes profile create`
4. Write `SOUL.md` files
5. Install skills per profile
6. Enable Bot Mode
7. Create a team group chat

- GitHub Repo: https://github.com/juliench82/hermes-agents-forge
